name: Biketerra SBS 3D (Viture, dev)
description: DEV / SANDBOX — side-by-side stereo 3D for Viture XR glasses via single-window double-render: ONE game instance, per-eye camera pose (±right·IPD/2), each eye rendered into a FULL-canvas offscreen (offscreen format lazily read from the real canvas backbuffer — the v0.7 root-cause fix for the poisoned 'sbs3d-pipeline'), then a composite pass samples both offscreens into the canvas halves (a canvas backbuffer can only be rendered to, never copied into). v0.7 also adds the dual-Eye HUD Mirror (right-half MutationObserver-cloned HUD, 2D canvases re-synced every 6 frames) and a stereo 3D cursor with a right→left interactive input bridge. Toggle / IPD / swap-eyes / HUD mirror in the on-screen chip. NOT shippable.
